body.name: Joint-margin-preserving Gaussian latent-control completion
body.construction: For \(B\in\mathcal B_G\), start with one draw of the entire observed vector from \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}\), retain all its coordinates unchanged, compute \(U_i=Y_i-s_iD_i\), and independently draw \(Z\sim N(0,I_K)\). Define \(A_i^B=D_i+U_i/B_i\) and \(\varepsilon_i^B=0\) when \(B_i\ne0\); define \(A_i^B=Z_i\) and \(\varepsilon_i^B=U_i\) when \(B_i=0\). Set \(\theta_i^B=s_i-B_i\) and \(f_i^B(A_i^B)=B_iA_i^B\), adding back the observed-control projection to \(f_i^B\) when lifting the residualized equation. The augmented joint law of the unchanged observed vector and \(A^B\) is \(P^B\), and its residualized structural equation is \(Y_i=\theta_i^BD_i+f_i^B(A_i^B)+\varepsilon_i^B\).
